note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: doctrine/sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter and highlighter; tokenizes, no syntax tree.

leads.name: jdorn/sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter; no syntax tree.

leads.name: iamcal/sql-parser
leads.reason: MySQL CREATE TABLE schema parser; cannot parse the SELECT or INSERT controls (scope mismatch).

leads.name: phpmyadmin/sql-parser
leads.reason: new Parser($sql) builds statement objects (SelectStatement, InsertStatement) with components; MySQL dialect.

leads.name: greenlion/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: PHPSQLParser->parse($sql) returns a nested array parse tree (SELECT, FROM, WHERE ...).

leads.name: nilportugues/sql-query-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter that returns text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: staabm/sql-parser-util
leads.reason: Utility extracted from doctrine/dbal 2.13 SQLParserUtils that rewrites named and list parameters into positional ones; it returns SQL text and parameters, no syntax tree.

leads.name: soundintheory/php-sql-parser
leads.family: PHP-SQL-Parser lineage (2013 fork; shared with greenlion)
leads.reason: (new PHPSQL\Parser())->parse($sql) returns the clause-keyed array tree of the PHP-SQL-Parser lineage. 2013 PSR-0 fork of the Google Code project whose continuation is greenlion; no file identical to greenlion v5.0.0 after php -w, 54.3% of normalized statements shared. Verified with both controls; runs on PHP 8.5 with compile-time warnings.

leads.name: jasny/persist-sql-query
leads.reason: Query builder; its QuerySplitter cuts SQL into clause strings with regular expressions and returns text parts, not a tree with functions or literals.

leads.name: sqlftw/sqlftw
leads.reason: Not open source: composer.json at v0.1.17 (codeberg.org/paranoiq/sqlftw, commit 75ad341c) declares license ["proprietary"], and the repository root checked on 2026-11-17 has no LICENSE file (README.md, build, composer.json, doc, rector.php, sources, tests). The protocol requires an open-source release.

leads.name: sad_spirit/pg_builder
leads.reason: Query builder backed by a full PostgreSQL parser: createFromString($sql) returns a typed Select/Insert AST walked with the library BlankWalker. One statement per call (a trailing ";" is rejected), so the adapter splits at the library Lexer's ";" tokens. Verified with both controls.

leads.name: getdkan/sql-parser
leads.reason: Abandoned state-machine validator for DKAN's bracketed SQL-like query strings ([SELECT ...][WHERE ...]); validate() returns a boolean and there is no statement tree. Requires PHP < 8.2.

leads.name: manticoresoftware/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical fork of the selected greenlion/php-sql-parser: 5,030 of 5,157 normalized statements (97.5%) also occur in greenlion v5.0.0 and 145 of 177 files are identical after php -w; it lacks greenlion's window-function processors and adds Manticore-specific Add/Alter/Source processors. A spot check gives the greenlion tree for both controls. Not promoted to avoid counting one parser twice.

leads.name: marcocesarato/sqlparser
leads.reason: LightSQLParser exposes only getMethod, getFields, getTable and getAllQueries (regular-expression extraction); no join, function or literal structure for the summary.

leads.name: flow-php/postgresql
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: PostgreSQL client library whose SQL parsing calls the flow-php/pg-query-ext native extension (libpg_query) and maps its protobuf tree to PHP objects (requires google/protobuf). Same native blocker as flow-php/pg-query-ext; not built this round.

leads.name: intersvyaz/yii2-sqlparser
leads.reason: Preprocessor for yii\db\Command SQL templates: expands special /*name ... */ and --*name comments and array parameters, returns SQL text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: jasny/dbquery-mysql
leads.reason: Abandoned on Packagist in favour of jasny/persist-sql-query; query builder with the same clause splitter design.

leads.name: flow-php/pg-query-ext
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: PHP C extension (ext/pg_query.c) linking libpg_query 18.0.0 statically; pg_query_parse($sql) returns libpg_query's JSON parse tree. The parser source is C, so parser-source coverage and AFL++ feedback need a Clang-instrumented libpg_query plus extension and an AFL++-linked PHP runtime with an allowlist (the source-built pear/xml_parser pattern) and a path-specific overlay audit; not built this round. Shared libpg_query family with the selected C libpg_query path.

leads.name: tsukasa/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Code-style reformat of greenlion 4.x: 4,549 of 4,922 normalized statements (92.4%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, and the sampled differences are cosmetic (else if to elseif, closing tags, array syntax).

leads.name: udan11/sql-parser
leads.reason: Predecessor name of the selected phpmyadmin/sql-parser: Packagist marks it abandoned in favour of phpmyadmin/sql-parser and its repository is github.com/phpmyadmin/sql-parser (rename precedent: zend-json, trust-dns-proto).

leads.name: processfast/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical greenlion fork (2019): 4,764 of 4,825 normalized statements (98.7%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, 132 of 170 files identical after php -w.

leads.name: liquipedia/sqllint
leads.reason: Lint wrapper around phpmyadmin/sql-parser that reports errors; no own tree and no summary beyond the selected phpMyAdmin parser.

leads.name: crodas/sql-parser
leads.reason: (new SQLParser)->parse($sql) returns SQL\Select/SQL\Insert objects built by a PHP LEMON-generated parser; public getters expose tables, joins, columns, where, group, order, fields and values. Verified with both controls; 2016 code runs on PHP 8.5 with deprecations.

leads.name: michabbb/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: 2014 snapshot of greenlion 4.0.0 (self-described fork); 4,204 of 4,985 normalized statements (84.3%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0, the remainder being older code of the same project.

leads.name: fmizzell/sql-parser
leads.reason: Same package description and repository (github.com/GetDKAN/sql-parser) as getdkan/sql-parser; validator for DKAN query strings, no statement tree.

leads.name: aitradeinc/php-sql-parser
leads.reason: Near-identical greenlion copy: 4,826 of 4,852 normalized statements (99.5%) occur in greenlion v5.0.0.

leads.name: offsite-solutions/eisodos-sqlparser
leads.reason: Eisodos framework template renderer for <%SQL%...%SQL%> blocks (returns rendered text); not an SQL syntax parser.

leads.name: codexsoft/sql-parser
leads.reason: Statement splitter: parseString strips comment lines and explodes the text into statement strings; no syntax tree.

leads.name: subapp/sql
leads.reason: README documents an AST parser, but 1.2.2 requires symfony/yaml 4.2.0-BETA2, which Composer 2.11 refuses to install because of five Packagist security advisories (PKSA-nktx-f1n1-b4yd and others). The advisory block was not overridden, so the controls were not run.

leads.name: xp-forge/sql-parser
leads.reason: Primary control fails in v0.4.0 (README: not yet complete): Parser->parse(...)->tree() throws text\sql\parse\Expecting "Expecting ; or (eof), have AS on line 2" at the table alias; the INSERT control parses.

leads.name: cadfael/mysql-antlr4-parser
leads.reason: No tagged release on Packagist (dev-main only), so no release can be pinned; 2 lifetime downloads.

leads.name: inilim/sqlite-parser
leads.reason: Spot check: Parser::parse returns a Script whose SelectStatement carries columns, from, joins, where, groupBy and orderBy for the primary control. Not promoted this round: the only release (2026-11-10, 1 lifetime download) has neither LICENSE nor README in its archive (composer.json declares MIT; the README exists only on main after the tag).

leads.name: k-kinzal/sql-parser
leads.reason: Zero Packagist downloads and no tagged release (dev-main only).
